title: SSC - Logical Reasoning - Statement And Assumption
subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: Statement: Many historians have done more harm than good by distorting truth. Assumptions: People believe what is reported by the historians. Historians are seldom expected to depict the truth.

Neither I nor II is implicit

Only II is implicit
Only III is implicit
